REPRESENTATION INTERACTION

      |

|                                                                                                    |

|                                       v                                                            |

|                                       |                                                            |
|                                       v                                                            |

|      hover + source location | reveal | rectangle | collapse subtree | toggle highlight             |

        |

        |
        +-- rectangle selection / reference buffer
        |      (O) src/components/DiagramView.tsx:completeSelection

        |                 |

        |
        +-- component capture or edit
        |      (O) src/components/DiagramView.tsx:saveCapture/editMode
        |          released rectangle -> component capture; report completion
        |          disable incompatible actions; ASCII editor; start/exit edit session
        |          captured component returns to component lineage
        |
        +-- layer feedback
        |      ordered transition target remains bound to the indexed revision
        |

               (O) src/App.tsx:revealCodeEntity

                      | stable element -> Evidence identity + source-range index
                      v

                      v
